content.text: 上海今天天气怎么样？请务必调用 get_weather 工具查询，不要凭空回答。
The user is asking about the weather in Shanghai today, and explicitly asks me to call the get_weather tool rather than making up an answer. I should call the tool with the city parameter "上海".

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city
